title: quality-gates contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-11). The SHAPE of the engineering-quality-gate-ladder contract data the graft Step-7.5 branches on. Shape is normative here; the gate SEMANTICS (autonomy gradient, fail-fast, discovery-fallback) live in the gateway / faff-graft prose.
